foto: Close-up of a white plastic toilet brush holder bucket with its lid closed on the bathroom floor. The brush handle pokes out slightly, and the clear lid has a faint dingy film inside. Soft daylight from a small window, white square wall tiles behind, no person, no text.

Wide shot of the same white toilet with the seat lid lowered over a brush handle, the bristles hanging inside the bowl to dry. The brush handle rests across the rim. Soft morning light fills the small white-tiled bathroom, no person, no text.

Two unlabeled spray bottles, one bleach and one vinegar, sit side by side on a white tile counter, almost touching, with a faint chemical smell suggested by a slight blur. No hands, soft daylight from a small window, white porcelain sink edge in background, no text.

A single unlabeled spray bottle stands alone on a white tile shelf near the sink, with a folded white rag beside it. A hand in a light lilac sleeve is not touching it yet, giving space. Soft daylight, clean composition, no text.

Two simple spray bottles, one white vinegar and one peroxide, sit on separate shelves with a clear gap between them. A small printed label on each? No text. A hand in a lilac sleeve points to one bottle only. Soft daylight, white cabinet.

Loretta's wrinkled hands lift the white plastic toilet seat and lay the wet brush handle across the rim so the bristles hang over the bowl, face not visible, lilac apron edge just in frame. White tiles and daylight.
Loretta's hand lowers the seat lid down onto the brush handle, holding it in place, with the brush bristles visible hanging over the water below. Close-up from side, soft daylight.
Loretta's hand pours brown hydrogen peroxide from its brown bottle into the white brush holder on the floor, with a splash visible. The closed holder is open, no brush inside. White tiles background.
Wide shot of the toilet with the seat lid down and the brush handle lying across the rim, bristles hanging over the bowl, drying. A clean white bathroom with soft morning light, no person.
Close-up of a toilet bowl being scrubbed aggressively with a white brush, only the inside bowl visible, water suds, no outside base or seat. Bright white porcelain, hand in lilac sleeve. No text.
Loretta's hand wipes the outside base of the toilet with a folded white rag, the plastic seat and floor seam visible, face not visible. Soft daylight, white tiles, clean composition.
Loretta's wrinkled hand dips an old toothbrush into a small clear glass of white vinegar, the brush head submerged. A hand mirror lies on the sink edge nearby. Soft daylight, white tiles.
Loretta's hand holds a small hand mirror up under the toilet rim, reflecting a brown and gray film. Her eye is not visible, just the hand and mirror. Soft daylight, white porcelain.
The old toothbrush reaches up under the toilet rim, scrubbing the hidden curve, while the other hand holds the mirror. White tiles and porcelain, no face visible.
A clean white underside of the toilet rim after scrubbing, with no brown film, the porcelain bright. A hand withdraws the toothbrush. Soft daylight.

Extreme close-up of the underside of a white toilet rim, showing a brown and gray film line where the water never reaches. A small round hand mirror is angled to reflect the hidden area. Soft daylight, white porcelain, no text.

Extreme close-up of the same underside of the white toilet rim after scrubbing, now bright white with no brown film. An old damp toothbrush rests on the closed seat nearby. Soft daylight, clean white porcelain, no text.

An old analog timer next to a hand mirror and an old toothbrush on the white bathroom sink. The timer shows five minutes, though no numbers are legible. A hand in lilac sleeve adjusts it. Soft daylight, white tiles.
Loretta's hand turns the shut-off valve behind the toilet, with the white porcelain tank behind her. The valve is chrome. Soft daylight, white tiles.
Loretta's hand presses the flush handle, and the water drops below the ring in the bowl, revealing the brown mineral ring. Close-up of the bowl and handle.
Loretta's hand pours one cup of white vinegar directly onto the brown ring at the waterline; the liquid clings to the porcelain. Soft daylight.
Loretta's wet pumice stone rubs gently on the brown ring, with a small dish of water next to the toilet. The ring begins to lift. Close-up.
A dry pumice stone rests on the dry white porcelain rim, no water nearby, with a slight scratch mark on the porcelain surface. Bright daylight, no hand, no text.
A wet pumice stone being dipped into a small dish of water beside the toilet, drops of water visible on the stone. A hand in lilac sleeve holds it. Soft daylight.
Close-up of the toilet bowl at the waterline showing a brown and gray mineral ring, no hands, bright white porcelain otherwise clean. Soft daylight from window, white tiles behind.
Close-up of the same toilet bowl after pumice cleaning, the waterline bright white with no ring, water clear. Soft daylight, white tiles, clean.
